    Class FeatureAffineCommand

    Apply an affine transform to a fixed set of arcs and point shapes, reversing it on undo via the analytically-computed inverse matrix.

    Same lightweight in-place semantics as FeatureTranslateCommand: O(touched-vertices), composes freely with other commands in one undo timeline, no dataset replacement, selection survives.

    Example

    Runnable example association: attribute-editing, china-editing, draw-snap-clear.
